engine.name: Wafel libsm64 direct-frame harness
engine.execution: Direct C ABI calls to sm64_update in Wafel's unlocked sm64_jp.dll under Wine on roach

detector.reason_for_threshold: The threshold is less than one sixth of the reconstructed incident displacement and above every bounded legal-path result.

differential_self_test.timing_relation: The N64 executes this game update every two VIs: (150-102)/2 = 24 native steps.

clean_campaigns.name: single_frame_400m
clean_campaigns.profile: Broad randomized one-frame states plus a 25% exact reconstruction arm; all four TTC speed modes

clean_campaigns.name: exact_reconstruction_stopped_100m
clean_campaigns.profile: x=800, y=-4207, z=1900, vy=-20, ACT_FREEFALL, TTC_SPEED_STOPPED; randomized yaw/input and evolving legal world state

clean_campaigns.name: grid_reconstruction_stopped_6m
clean_campaigns.profile: Every integer X/Z point in x=700..1250, z=1450..2150 at y=-4207, vy=-20 and ACT_FREEFALL; 16 independent passes at TTC_SPEED_STOPPED

clean_campaigns.name: envelope16_short_1_6m
clean_campaigns.profile: Sixteen-frame episodes over the reconstructed x/y/z and velocity bounds, 17 relevant action states, randomized controller inputs, TTC_SPEED_STOPPED

aggregate_clean_coverage.claim: No tested legal state produced a one-frame rise of 500 units, versus the reconstructed 3155.25-unit incident displacement.

scope_limits: Random campaigns are bounded searches, not an exhaustive proof over every 32-bit game state.
The integer X/Z grid is exhaustive only over its stated envelope, Y, velocity, action, and resolution.

The native engine is not the original MIPS binary; its incident trajectory was therefore differentially checked against the instrumented N64 emulator, and source-level bounds are used for the decisive freefall/platform exclusions.
No original input movie, savestate, RAM dump, or console hardware survives, so the physical initiator cannot be identified.
